change_rule: Any change to a frozen field creates FAIR-CMP-v2 with a written reason; results under different protocol ids are not pooled.

dev_ids_csv.note: not copied: the validated Week 6 file is referenced by path + hash

object_order.definition: row order of dev_ids.csv (= benchmark order restricted to dev); row_index 0..11999
object_order.ordered_inputs_sha256_rule: sha256(json.dumps([[image_id, sha256], ...], sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'))) — the key every embedding manifest must carry

dataset.image_to_object: one Europeana record = one museum object = one image (first preview, else source image)

definitions.hs1: first digit of the Hornbostel-Sachs notation of the first HS concept (common.hs_level rule)
definitions.hs3: first three digits of the same notation; benchmark keeps HS3/family/name classes with >= 30 objects

evaluation_masks.rule: score a row for label L iff L != "" in dev_ids.csv; clustering always uses all 12,000 rows

dataset.reserved_data: reserved (heldout + excluded_pilot_overlap) objects are never embedded, clustered, scored or used for selection under this protocol; P5A must lock its own object-level validation split before touching them

embeddings.shared_input_adaptation: PIL: ImageOps.exif_transpose -> convert(RGB) -> ImageOps.pad to a white (255,255,255) square of side max(w,h); then the checkpoint's own evaluation transform. Because the image is already square, resize+center-crop (timm, OpenCLIP) and squash (SigLIP) all reduce to an aspect-preserving full-image resize: no part of the instrument is cropped.
embeddings.storage: float32 .npy, one row per manifest row in manifest order, under data/<family>/emb/dev/ (git-ignored); a tracked JSON manifest records checkpoint, revision, weight sha256, transform repr, array sha256, shape and ordered_inputs_sha256
embeddings.alignment_gate: ordered_inputs_sha256 must equal 112d1630d339de97348095911a4ed07cd49f8644d65f6d52d75a11bb43317f37; arrays must be finite with shape (12000, d)
embeddings.device_precision: CPU, torch float32 inference (no autocast/fp16); torch.manual_seed(42); 4-6 torch threads (inference is deterministic per input; threads affect speed only)

clip.transform: OpenCLIP eval: resize shortest side 224 (bicubic) + center crop 224; mean (0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073), std (0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711)
clip.output: encode_image() projected image embedding, L2-normalised at extraction
clip.license_per_model_card: MIT (Hugging Face API cardData.license, checked 2026-11-19; repo head revision == pinned revision)

siglip.output: encode_image() pooled image embedding, L2-normalised at extraction
siglip.license_per_model_card: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face API cardData.license, checked 2026-11-19; repo head revision == pinned revision)

dinov2_b.license_per_model_card: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face API cardData.license, checked 2026-11-19; repo head revision == pinned revision)
dinov2_b.transform: timm eval transform with input_size 224, crop_pct 1.0: Resize(224, bicubic) + CenterCrop(224); ImageNet mean/std
dinov2_b.output: CLS token after final LayerNorm (forward_intermediates norm=True); layer -1 == pooled output (asserted at run time); not L2-normalised at extraction

dinov2_s.license_per_model_card: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face API cardData.license, checked 2026-11-19; repo head revision == pinned revision)
dinov2_s.status: P1 to extract on dev; pilot-only so far

dinov2_l.license_per_model_card: Apache-2.0 (Hugging Face API cardData.license, checked 2026-11-19; repo head revision == pinned revision)
dinov2_l.status: P1 to extract on dev; pilot-only so far

rule_for_new_encoders: same 12,000 rows, same order, same alignment gate
same shared input adaptation, then the checkpoint's own evaluation transform at its NATIVE resolution; record native and used resolution separately
image-only forward pass; record exactly which output is used (pooled/projected embedding for VLM encoders, final-LN CLS for SSL ViTs, documented pooling for embedding LLMs)
record checkpoint id + revision, weight sha256, licence, embedding dim, dtype, seconds, threads, peak RSS
DINOv2 S/B/L (P1) are compared at 224 px so that only model size changes; 518 px is a separate, labelled resolution arm
model families are not assumed to share native preprocessing; a model whose native transform crops (crop_pct<1) still receives the white-square-padded image first

primary_controlled_reference.primary_metric: HS3 AMI (mean over seeds); ARI reported with equal prominence

k_policy.fixed_k_note: predeclared anchor, not tuned on labels
k_policy.label_informed_reference: k = 13 (= number of HS3 benchmark classes); reported in a separate table, never called blind
k_policy.blind_k: P3/P12: select k from label-free criteria only (silhouette, elbow, eigengap, BIC) on the same rows; HS labels are read only after k is fixed

representations.centered_l2: X - mean(X over the 12,000 clustered rows), then row L2 (primary)
representations.l2: row L2 only (control; collapses VLM agglomerative)
representations.pca50_l2 / pca100_l2: PCA(n, svd_solver='full', whiten=False) fitted on the clustered rows, then row L2
representations.fit_scope: every transform is fitted on the clustered rows only, label-free; features cast to float32 (GMM to float64)

kmeans.distance: euclidean (= cosine ranking on L2 rows)

numerics.note: 4 BLAS threads are part of the protocol: 6 threads changed PCA results by up to 2.3e-5 in P5
numerics.environment: requirements-pilot.lock.txt (Python 3.12.3, numpy 2.5.4, scikit-learn 1.9.1, torch 2.15.0+cpu, timm 1.0.30, open_clip_torch 3.3.0)

external_metrics.levels: HS3 primary; HS1, HS2, family, name secondary

internal_metrics.silhouette: cosine silhouette on the clustered representation, on a fixed 4,000-row sample: np.random.default_rng(0).choice(12000, 4000, replace=False); HDBSCAN noise rows excluded
internal_metrics.largest_cluster_pct: 100 * size of largest non-noise cluster / 12,000 (report max over seeds)
internal_metrics.noise_fraction: share of rows labelled -1 (HDBSCAN only; 0 otherwise)
internal_metrics.runtime: wall-clock seconds of fit_predict only (time.perf_counter), 4 threads; transform time recorded separately; embedding time per model in its manifest

hdbscan_noise.primary: noise_as_cluster: all 12,000 rows scored, label -1 treated as one extra cluster
hdbscan_noise.secondary: assigned_only: score only rows with label != -1 and report coverage; never quote assigned_only without coverage

evaluation.invalid_labels: rows with an empty label at level L are clustered but excluded from that level's external metrics; n_evaluated is always reported (currently 12,000 at every level)
evaluation.seed_aggregation: mean over seeds 0-4 and sample SD (ddof=1) for AMI and ARI; min/max kept in per-run files; largest_cluster_pct reported as the worst (max) seed; deterministic methods have n_seeds = 1 and no SD. Seed-to-seed partition agreement (pairwise ARI) is reported in P3.
evaluation.statistics: no significance claims without paired seeds or bootstrap over objects; any difference < 2 x seed SD is reported as no clear difference
evaluation.leakage: labels are read only after every fit of a grid has been saved (fit stage then score stage)

baselines.status: immutable references for every later comparison
